# test_intersection.py
import pytest

from your_module import intersection  # Replace with the actual module name


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "lst1,lst2,expected",
    [
        pytest.param([1, 2, 3], [2, 3, 4], [2, 3], id="basic-overlap"),
        pytest.param([3, 2, 1], [1, 2, 3], [3, 2, 1], id="preserves-lst1-order"),
        pytest.param([1, 2, 2, 3, 2, 4], [2, 4, 4], [2, 4], id="deduplicates-result"),
        pytest.param(["a", "b", "a", "c"], ["c", "a"], ["a", "c"], id="strings"),
        pytest.param([(1, 2), (3, 4), (1, 2)], [(1, 2)], [(1, 2)], id="hashable-tuples"),
    ],
)
def test_intersection_happy_paths(lst1, lst2, expected):
    assert intersection(lst1, lst2) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "lst1,lst2,expected",
    [
        pytest.param([], [], [], id="both-empty"),
        pytest.param([], [1, 2], [], id="empty-lst1"),
        pytest.param([1, 2], [], [], id="empty-lst2"),
        pytest.param([1, 2], [3, 4], [], id="no-overlap"),
        pytest.param([None, "x", None], [None], [None], id="none-values"),
    ],
)
def test_intersection_edge_cases(lst1, lst2, expected):
    assert intersection(lst1, lst2) == expected


def test_intersection_preserves_first_matching_value_from_lst1():
    # True == 1 and False == 0 in Python, so this verifies that the function
    # preserves the first matching item from lst1 and deduplicates by equality.
    result = intersection([True, 1, False, 0], [1, 0])

    assert result == [True, False]
    assert result[0] is True
    assert result[1] is False


def test_intersection_does_not_modify_inputs_and_returns_new_list():
    lst1 = [1, 2, 2, 3]
    lst2 = [2, 3]

    original_lst1 = lst1.copy()
    original_lst2 = lst2.copy()

    result = intersection(lst1, lst2)

    assert result == [2, 3]
    assert lst1 == original_lst1
    assert lst2 == original_lst2
    assert result is not lst1
    assert result is not lst2

        pytest.param([1], 123, id="lst2-non-iterable"),
    ],
)
def test_intersection_raises_type_error_for_invalid_inputs(lst1, lst2):
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        intersection(lst1, lst2)
